caption:
Hybi's weekly recap for Apr 5–10, with this week's comics in one place.

Getting into a tall car, hold the handle, sit bottom-first and swing both legs in together. For the bottom rack of the dishwasher, kneeling on one knee can ease the load on your back. Removalists can keep loads close and turn with their feet, not their back. Carrying trays? Rest them on your whole palm.

Scroll back through the week for the full comics. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios, chiropractors and remedial massage therapists can help. Book online via the link in bio
